summary: 围绕饮用水加氟的争论既涉及防蛀证据，也涉及人在不确定条件下如何权衡风险和选择权。文章用科学史和社会学的视角分析双方为何得出不同结论。
logic: 检查对科学共识的假设
引入科学史和价值判断

paragraphs.brief: 疏导是公共供水中添加氟，目的是减少牙齿腐烂。
sentences: Fluoridation is the addition of fluorine to public water supplies with the aim of reducing tooth decay.
疏导是公共供水中添加氟，目的是减少牙齿腐烂。

The fluorine, when mixed with water, becomes fluoride and the desired concentration of fluoride in public water is approximately one part per million, depending on the regional temperature and hence the amount of water people are likely to drink.
氟与水混合后，会变成氟化物，而公共水中所期望的氟化物浓度约为百万分之一，这取决于区域温度，因此，人们可能饮用的水量。
Many studies, such as those by McClure in 1970 through to Burt in 1983, have shown that when children drink fluoridated water, their average rate of tooth decay seems greatly reduced.
许多研究，例如麦克卢尔1970年到1983年一直到伯特的研究，都表明，当儿童饮用氟化水时，其平均牙衰减率似乎大大降低。
A typical figure claimed is 50 percent reduction.
声称的典型数字是减少50%。
This apparently enormous benefit for children’s teeth is the major argument in favor of fluoridation.
这显然给儿童牙齿带来巨大好处，这是赞成放风的主要论点。

paragraphs.brief: 已经表达了反对流感的三个主要理由。
sentences: Three main grounds for opposition to fluoridation have been expressed.
已经表达了反对流感的三个主要理由。
First, opponents claim the benefits are exaggerated or not established.
首先，反对者声称这些好处是夸大或没有确定。
Second, there are claims of health risks to parts of the population, for example, allergic reactions.
第二，对部分人口的健康风险，例如过敏反应。
It is also accepted that high levels of fluoride can cause discoloration of otherwise healthy teeth.
人们也同意，氟化物含量高会导致本来健康的牙齿变色。

Proponents do not consider this to be a problem in such small concentrations, whereas opponents disagree—especially because some people drink more water and obtain much more than the standard 1 milligram of fluoride per day.
支持者并不认为这是一个如此小的浓度问题，而反对者则不同意，特别是因为有些人饮用更多的水，每天获得的氟化物比标准1毫克多得多。
Third, fluoridation is thought to be an infringement on individual rights because it is compulsory medication of all members of a community.
第三，流感被认为是对个人权利的侵犯，因为它是社区所有成员的强制性药物。

paragraphs.brief: 了解疏松问题具有重要影响。
sentences: An understanding of the fluoridation issue has important implications.
了解疏松问题具有重要影响。
If, according to the experts, fluoridation is unquestionably a beneficial and non-hazardous measure, then the wisdom of allowing the public to vote on, and reject it must be questioned.
如果根据专家的意见，流水无疑是一种有益和无害的措施，那么允许公众投票和拒绝投票的智慧必须受到质疑。

paragraphs.brief: 几乎所有已经进行的研究都假定，争议的科学方面是没有问题的，它们将科学排除在社会学审查之外。
sentences: Almost all studies that have been done have assumed that the scientific aspects of the controversy are unproblematic, and they have excluded science from sociological examination.
几乎所有已经进行的研究都假定，争议的科学方面是没有问题的，它们将科学排除在社会学审查之外。
The traditional view is that science is a special kind of knowledge, which is established through scientific methods and objectively applied by members of a scientific community.
传统的观点是，科学是一种特殊的知识，通过科学方法建立，并由科学界成员客观地应用。

However, in recent years there has been a major challenge to this picture by a sociology of science that shows how scientific knowledge is socially negotiated, and inevitably linked to the values of the relevant parties, both scientists and nonscientists.
然而，近年来，社会科学学对这一图象提出了重大挑战，表明科学知识是如何经过社会谈判的，并且不可避免地与相关各方，包括科学家和非科学家的价值观联系在一起。
These challengers do not see scientific knowledge as exempt from social inquiry.
这些挑战者并不认为科学知识可以免于社会调查。

paragraphs.brief: Kuhn(1970年)认为，科学知识并不总是作为一个有秩序的过程发展，而是以周期性革命为特征，在这种革命中，研究方法和评估标准以支离破碎的方式发生变化。
sentences: Kuhn (1970) argued that scientific knowledge does not always develop as an orderly process, but is characterized by periodic revolutions, in which the methods of study and the assessment criteria change in a fragmented way.
Kuhn(1970年)认为，科学知识并不总是作为一个有秩序的过程发展，而是以周期性革命为特征，在这种革命中，研究方法和评估标准以支离破碎的方式发生变化。

According to Kuhn, the shift from one scientific way of thinking to another is not made solely on the basis of clear rules of formal scientific practice, but can include social factors, though Kuhn has never developed a full analysis of what these might be.
库恩认为，从一种科学思维方式转向另一种思维方式并非完全基于正式科学实践的明确规则，而是可以包括社会因素，尽管库恩从未对这些可能是什么进行全面分析。

Collins (1975) took this concept further when he asserted that the outcome of experiments was not something whose meaning could be immediately comprehended, but rather something for interpretation, discussion between scientists, and reinterpretation in the light of other experiments.
柯林斯(1975年)进一步采纳了这一概念，他说，实验的结果不是可以立即理解的含义，而是可以解释、科学家之间讨论和根据其他实验重新解释的内容。

paragraphs.brief: 对这一科学分析的一种解释是，事实和理论以及科学知识和价值观之间的传统区别不再合理。
sentences: One interpretation of this analysis of science is that traditional distinctions between facts and theories, and between scientific knowledge and values, can no longer be justified.
对这一科学分析的一种解释是，事实和理论以及科学知识和价值观之间的传统区别不再合理。
Because social processes are involved at all stages of the creation, evaluation, and establishing of scientific knowledge, social values may also be involved.
由于社会进程涉及科学知识的创造、评价和确立的所有阶段，社会价值观也可能涉及。

paragraphs.brief: Sutton的详细研究使人怀疑氟化导致牙齿衰减的程度。
sentences: In the same way as many scientists who study fluoridation have overlooked social values, sociologists have also downplayed an important part of the debate by ignoring the number of eminent scientists who have questioned aspects of fluoridation.
正如许多研究氟化的科学家忽视社会价值观一样，社会学家也忽视了辩论的一个重要部分，忽视了质疑氟化的知名科学家的人数。

An example is the study by Sutton in 1960, which analyzed the classic North American studies of the effect of fluoridation on tooth decay, and found that each showed significant methodological shortcomings.
1960年Sutton的研究就是一个例子，它分析了北美典型的关于氟化对牙齿衰减的影响的研究，发现每一项研究都显示出在方法上的重大缺陷。
Sutton’s detailed study throws doubt as to the extent of reductions in tooth decay from fluoridation.
Sutton的详细研究使人怀疑氟化导致牙齿衰减的程度。
Yet Sutton’s book is not cited in a single analysis of the fluoridation issue by any sociologist.
然而，任何社会学家都没有在一次分析中引用Sutton的书。

paragraphs.brief: 一位对手可能会说：“ 尽管关于流感的好处的证据是巨大的，但还是有疑问的。
sentences: In a situation of some scientific uncertainty, differences in values are highlighted.
在某种科学不确定性的情况下，人们强调了价值观的差异。
A supporter of fluoridation might argue, ‘The evidence for the benefits of fluoridation is quite substantial, while the evidence for harm is limited and dubious.
支持流感的人可能会说：“ 流感的好处的证据相当多，而伤害的证据却有限且可疑。
I think the likely benefits outweigh the possible dangers; hence I support fluoridation because it is the cheapest and easiest way to make sure every child reaps the benefits.’
我认为可能的好处大于可能的危险；因此，我支持放任自流，因为这是确保每个儿童都得到好处的最便宜和最简单的方式。
An opponent might argue, ‘Though the evidence for the benefits of fluoridation is substantial, there is some doubt about it.
一位对手可能会说：“ 尽管关于流感的好处的证据是巨大的，但还是有疑问的。
Since fluoridation is not necessary for good teeth, we should forgo the benefits if there is some slight chance of harm.
由于流利不是好牙齿所必须的，如果有轻微的伤害可能性，我们就应该放弃好处。
Some scientists claim that a small percentage of the population could be harmed by fluoride.
一些科学家声称，一小部分人口可能受到氟化物的伤害。
Therefore, I oppose fluoridation of water supplies and favor the voluntary use of fluoride tablets by those who want to take them.’
因此，我反对水供应的疏松，赞成那些想取用氟化物药片的人自愿使用这些药片。

paragraphs.brief: 这两种论点都考虑了有关水分疏松的科学证据，但在对社会效益和成本的评估方面却有所不同。
sentences: Both arguments consider the scientific evidence concerning fluoridation, but differ in their assessments of the social benefits and costs.
这两种论点都考虑了有关水分疏松的科学证据，但在对社会效益和成本的评估方面却有所不同。

This difference is not between rationality and irrationality but is a legitimate difference in values, for example, the positive value placed on good teeth, the negative value placed on possible health risks, and the social benefits or costs of compulsory or voluntary intake of fluorides.
这种差别不是在合理性和不合理性之间，而是价值上的合理差别，例如，对良好牙齿的正面价值、对可能的健康风险的负面价值以及强制或自愿摄入氟化物的社会效益或成本。

paragraphs.brief: 从社会学的角度来看，反对流感并不一定是非理性的。
sentences: From the sociological point of view, opposition to fluoridation is not necessarily irrational.
从社会学的角度来看，反对流感并不一定是非理性的。
Rather, claims to rationality and to scientific authority are better seen as part of a strategy to promote fluoridation than as incontrovertible statements of fact.
相反，主张理性和科学权威更被视为促进流畅的战略的一部分，而不是无可争议的事实陈述。
Second, social values are likely to be bound up in any decision about fluoridation, so this is not an issue on which declarations by scientific experts ought to be considered the final word.
第二，社会价值观很可能与任何关于疏松的决定联系在一起，因此，科学专家的声明不应被视为最终词。

items.en: The optimum amount of fluoride in fluoridated water is calculated partly according to
items.zh: 氟化水中氟化物的最佳含量部分根据

items.en: One reason given by the writer for opposing fluoridation is that
items.zh: 作者为反对低潮给出的一个理由是：
correct: obligatory fluoridation takes away personal freedom.
强制性的氟化会剥夺个人自由。

items.en: The writer mentions Kuhn in order to
correct: show that science can be influenced by non-scientific considerations.
表明科学可以受到非科学因素的影响。

items.en: What did Sutton’s research discover about earlier studies in North America?
items.zh: Sutton的研究对早期在北美的研究有何发现？
correct: There were failings in the way they were carried out.
执行这些步骤的方式存在缺陷。

items.en: In the last paragraph, what does the writer say about scientists?
items.zh: 在最后一段作者怎么说科学家？
correct: They should not decide the fluoridation policy.
他们不应决定低潮政策。

items.en: Scientific knowledge should be kept separate from social values.
items.zh: 科学知识应当与社会价值观分开。
items.why: 作者指出，把科学知识与价值观截然分开的传统做法已难以成立。题干主张两者应当分离，与原意相反。

items.en: Many sociologists have disregarded the doubts that some scientists have concerning fluoridation.
items.zh: 许多社会学家忽视了某些科学家对流感的怀疑。
items.why: 原文指出，社会学家淡化了争论中的一个部分，忽视了一批知名科学家对加氟提出的质疑，与题干一致。

items.en: Sutton’s findings have been given insufficient attention by scientists outside of North America.
items.zh: 北美以外的科学家对萨顿的调查结果重视不够。
items.why: 原文说社会学家的相关分析没有引用萨顿的书。题干换成“北美以外的科学家”，对这批人的地域和关注程度，原文均无统计。

items.en: There are valid arguments on both sides of the fluoridation debate.
items.zh: 这场激烈辩论的两面都有有效的论据。
items.why: 原文写道“这两种论点都考虑了有关水分疏松的科学证据，但在对社会效益和成本的评估方面却有所不同”，支持题干所说的“这场激烈辩论的两面都有有效的论据”。

groups.label: 观点判断 · YES / NO / NOT GIVEN

items.en: The traditional view of science is that
items.answer: B · science is an unbiased discipline.

items.en: A sociological view of science argues that
items.zh: 科学的社会学观点认为：
items.answer: G · scientific knowledge is affected by the beliefs of everyone concerned.
items.solution: 科学知识受到所有有关人的信仰的影响。

items.en: Collins is of the opinion that
items.answer: A · the results of scientific research are not always understood at first.
items.solution: 最初并不总能理解科学研究的结果。

items.en: The writer suggests that a supporter of fluoridation may conclude that
items.zh: 作者建议支持流水者可以得出结论：
items.answer: D · there is insufficient proof to support a cautious approach.
items.solution: 没有足够的证据支持谨慎的做法。

items.en: The writer suggests that an opponent of fluoridation may conclude that
items.zh: 作者认为，一个反对流利的对手可以得出结论：
items.answer: C · people should be able to choose whether they want fluoride.
items.solution: 人们应该能够选择他们是否想要氟化物。

pairs: 题干用名词，定位句改用同词根的形容词。
第 1 段 · 第 2 句
points: 作者指出，把科学知识与价值观截然分开的传统做法已难以成立。题干主张两者应当分离，与原意相反。
题干问“柯林斯认为”。定位句写到“柯林斯(1975年)进一步采纳了这一概念，他说，实验的结果不是可以立即理解的含义，而是可以解释、科学家之间讨论和根据其他实验重新解释的内容”。
clauses: Many studies, such as those by McClure in 1970 through to Burt in 1983, have shown ….
“that when children drink fluoridated water, their average rate of tooth decay seems greatly reduced”补足 shown 的内容，交代究竟在说、判断或发现什么。
先读 shown 所在的主句，再把 that 后面的内容作为一个整体。
Proponents do not consider this to be a problem in such small concentrations, whereas opponents disagree— ….
连接词 because 引出“especially because some people drink more water and obtain much more than the standard 1 milligram of fluoride per day”，说明主句的原因关系。
先读主句的动作，再用 because 把这一层关系补进去。
lead: The long-standing debate about whether to fluoridate our drinking water continues
有关是否为饮用水提供水分的长期辩论仍在继续
